propositions: Quickstart examples in README.md and docs/user-guide.md teach bare `--assignee` handles (alice, bob) that are Jira-unresolvable and silently cleared by reconcile, contradicting docs/config.md which requires email or accountId
docs/README.md incorrectly routes 'Drive rebar over MCP' to llm-framework.md instead of the authoritative mcp-reference.md
docs/README.md describes config.md as documenting removed flat .rebar/config.conf parser, when docs/config.md already documents the parser as removed in favor of rebar.toml and [tool.rebar] table
pyproject.toml [tool.mypy] comment states non-core type-checking is advisory-only, but CI now gates mypy over the whole library per .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml
